name: enable_zapier_action
description: Enable an app's actions on this MCP server. Use discover_zapier_actions first to find the app ID, then enable_zapier_action to add it. Returns action details including the execute tool to use (execute_zapier_read_action or execute_zapier_write_action) and parameters. If authentication is required, also returns a URL to authenticate the app.

app.description: App name or identifier (e.g., 'gmail', 'jira', 'slack'). Accepts short names or full IDs from discover_zapier_actions.

action.description: Specific action key to enable. If omitted or '*', all actions for the app are enabled.
